explanation: Often you only want solutions inside a specific window, not all of them. The shaded blue band is the allowed interval [0, b] — slide b to widen or shrink it. The equation cos(x) = k has principal solutions acos(k) and 2π − acos(k); a solution stays GREEN only while it sits inside the band and turns gray the moment b shrinks past it. The pink dot sweeps only across the allowed window so the motion itself feels 'restricted'.
bullets: First find ALL solutions, then keep only those inside the interval [0, b].
cos(x) = k gives acos(k) and 2π − acos(k) on one period.
Shrinking the interval can drop a valid solution — moving b shows this live.
